snippet.title: Surf's Up - 1080p Dolphin Gameplay - Gamecube
snippet.description:
Gameplay from Surf's Up Please like and subscribe!

Dolphin emulator used. Gameplay starts at 1:18


Surf's Up is the video game based on the Sony Pictures Animation film of the same name. Surf's Up the video game follows the basic story of Cody Maverick in the movie. This game was developed by Ubisoft and is available for PC and for various console platforms. A signature feature has Shia LaBeouf, Jeff Bridges, Zooey Deschanel, Mario Cantone, Diedrich Bader, and Sal Masekela reprising their roles from the movie. An Xbox port for the game was announced, but was cancelled due to low sales for the system.
